title: Quote and confirm a multi-line service basket
guard: Validate one to twenty owned service selections, current pet/service/approved policy versions and common basket-level adjustment parameters; total visits<=60
effect: Calculate item prices deterministically with deferred order adjustments, then one basket combo and one order fee; persist owner-bound ten-minute QUOTE and use pure largest-remainder per-visit checkout allocation
alternative: Changed selection needs requote; unknown trait rule, incompatible policy, excessive tier or overflow rejects. No AI pricing, guessed tax or booking/payment mutation

title: Split boarding into employee care shifts
guard: Staff preview or authorized system finalize; matching checkout policy, booking NEEDS_REVIEW/version, valid confirmed customer durations and configured shift size
effect: Pure boardingCarePlan returns <=480-minute shift specifications with exact service-net remainder allocation; separate finalize transaction CASes booking, supersedes untouched old visits, inserts shifts and command/event
alternative: More than sixty shifts, past shifts, changed old visit count or stale version conflicts and rolls back; preview/helper themselves never write or certify attendance
persistenceSemantics: Return in-memory shift specifications; parent checkout transaction performs persistence

title: Start, update and stop consented foreground travel sharing
guard: Current assignee/active booking and start-minus120-minutes to endAt window; explicit sharing/version/session, fresh monotonic coordinates and current employee guard for writes
effect: Separate START/ARRIVED/STOP replace latest travel row and event; locate replaces only current observation; authorized ETA rechecks assignment/session/observedAt after provider call
alternative: No generic idempotency-key result store. Closed/stale/reassigned/stopped sessions hide coordinates; no append-only GPS trail or real-device/background acceptance claim

title: Request and decide a salary advance
guard: Signed effective active contract, approved advance policy, positive agreed amount<=50% monthly base, no concurrent pending advance and unused approved monthly quota
effect: Separate submit/approve/reject/owner-withdraw/payment-record commands serialize employee/month guards, version, exact replay and event/notification; only evidenced unique external transfer records PAID
alternative: Rejected/withdrawn requests release pending quota; stale/prior month/used quota/cap or reference conflict rejects. No interest, automatic transfer or invented statutory case

title: Prepare source-based payroll and selected payslip print
guard: Admin source preview with signed covering terms, completed single-month period and explicit attendance/statutory/consent references; current service credits/source versions
effect: Read-only preview returns deterministic breakdown/sourceHash; separate prepare revalidates sources in transaction, checks overlap/credit/advance allocation and creates PREPARED snapshot/source claims/event/command; selected print is presentation
alternative: SELF_REGISTERED automatic draft only supports full month without unpaid exceptions; availability is not attendance. Missing sources/changed hash/overlap fails instead of guessing salary deductions or KPI

title: Record a separate payroll adjustment
guard: Admin submits a version-bound positive integer SUPPLEMENT or RECOVERY with unique assessmentReference; only APPROVED/PAID original statements allow submission, RECOVERY requires PAID
effect: Separate SUBMITTED decisions APPROVE or REJECT require current version/reason. APPROVED SUPPLEMENT RECORD_PAYMENT requires original statement PAID and unique transfer claim, then becomes PAID. APPROVED RECOVERY RECONCILE requires agreement/resolution references, then becomes RECONCILED without automatic payroll/advance deduction
alternative: Wrong direction/action/state, reused assessment/transfer reference, stale version or changed replay fingerprint returns conflict; unresolved external payment is not recorded as confirmed

title: Inspect training readiness
guard: Active Admin and bounded500-row/eight-second source join; verify booking/review/completion credit/event and decision-time features, excluding synthetic or changed sources
effect: Return counts, exclusions, truncation, missing200-observation/50-group amounts and next step without private training rows or export key
alternative: Readiness does not export/train/import/approve/assign; budget timeout503 or truncation requires offline full audit
persistenceSemantics: Return counts/blockers only; no export/train/approval or business write

title: Export verified training observations
guard: Explicit --apply, new private backend/storage/ai JSONL path and32-character export secret; verified exact source join, >=200 observations, >=50 booking groups, no truncation
effect: HMAC opaque booking/review IDs and write private immutable wx/0600 JSONL, then source/hash manifest; dry run emits aggregate counts only
alternative: Source/path/existing output/data gate failure rejects. JSONL and manifest are sequential files and partial output may remain; no representative-quality, training or approval claim

title: Train and bundle a draft additive model
guard: Offline verified-label JSONL with unique opaque observations, five finite features and featuresAsOf<=decision<outcome; >=200 observations/50 booking groups
effect: Group-aware chronological80/20 holdout, purge crossing training groups, projected-gradient five weights and baseline MAE; write DRAFT model then evidence sequentially; separately validate and ZIP matching files
alternative: Insufficient disjoint rows/groups, temporal leakage or hash mismatch rejects; partial files may remain. Bundle does not import/approve/activate and OSRM is not satisfaction ground truth

title: Import draft artifact and evidence
guard: Authenticated Admin; exact DRAFT artifact<=32KB, past trainedUntil, valid weights/MAE/counts, matching original-byte SHA256 and chronological verified-label evidence
effect: Read immutable model version; same artifact/evidence returns existing view, otherwise create DRAFT with private original artifact/evidence/content hash and reviewVersion0
alternative: Version with different bytes/evidence409; import has content/version idempotence, not a generic command-key store. Separate independent source/evaluation review required before approval

title: Approve and activate a reviewed model
guard: Separate DRAFT import and independent source/evaluation process; review request validates current ADMIN, operation fingerprint, activation guard and reviewVersion
effect: APPROVE verifies original artifact/evidence hashes, chronological provenance and improved MAE, retires prior approved models, CAS activates selected model and records durable review in one transaction; RETIRE is a separate alternative
alternative: Missing/mismatched evidence, unimproved MAE or stale review version rejects with no partial activation. ReviewReference is not proof of independent actor; inference falls back to rules if no usable approved model

title: Retire model and use rule fallback
guard: Admin RETIRE request with current model reviewVersion/key/reason/reference; current active Admin and activation guard rechecked transactionally
effect: Explicit RETIRE CAS and review audit/result share transaction; separate ranking read validates approved model hash/weights/improved MAE and falls back to approved explainable policy when absent/invalid
alternative: Runtime validation failure does not persist RETIRE. Another approved usable model may remain; otherwise rules apply. No pricing/eligibility/assignment or financial mutation

title: Check vet-escort route and appointment feasibility
guard: Owned confirmed pets/home/clinic and same-day slot; vet-specific appointment/wait15..240/return scope; real road legs and buffered whole plan must fit
effect: Validate clinic outward/optional return legs<=45minutes with buffers, then bounded capability/schedule insertion/score and five-minute MATCH snapshot
alternative: Missing/long/unavailable/infeasible clinic plan returns review/conflict. Specialized clinic MATCH checkout explicitly returns MATCH_SCOPE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; recommendation never assigns or pays hospital costs

title: Advise an operational employee invitation shortlist
guard: Authoritative eligible sitter IDs supplied by dispatch, confirmed HOME point/pets; validate optional model and bounded schedule/statistics/routing with abort signal
effect: Up to four workers score feasible known profiles; return exact permutation including unscored original IDs and in-memory point-in-time feature snapshot
alternative: Routing/statistics failure cannot delete an otherwise eligible supplied ID; dispatch validates permutation or retains deterministic order. Only technical route cache may write, no invitation/assignment/money mutation
persistenceSemantics: Return ranked IDs and featureSnapshot in memory; no invitation/assignment/money write. Route cache may persist separately

title: Track and edit an owned pending application
guard: Verified active applicant account/current authEpoch, owned application or unowned legacy verified-contact match; edit requires PENDING/current version and exact allowed fields
effect: Owned GET decrypts allowlisted status/particulars/timeline without second OTP; separate update verifies new private documents then CASes encrypted PENDING fields and audit replay result under current owner guard
alternative: Processed record is read-only; current Admin review/owner edit race409, duplicate identity/cooldown denied. Self-edit cannot grant PET_SITTER or activate contract

title: Issue, sign and activate an employment document
guard: Each request requires current Admin/session/CSRF and its own payload-bound operation key. Save requires INTERVIEW stage, matching identity, applicationVersion and expectedRevision
effect: Separate save creates DRAFT; separate ISSUE checks latest DRAFT/hash/version and marks ISSUED; separate SIGN records real both-party/archive/date evidence and marks SIGNED. A later application APPROVE transaction promotes the eligible account, calls activate with the same session, creates the contract/status and commits application/audit/mail intent together
alternative: Each request replays only its own same-key/payload outcome; stale revision/hash/state or missing signed contract returns conflict and approval rollback. No signature is fabricated

title: Prefill and print a versioned contract
guard: Admin-authorized application and selected immutable document revision; optional prefill only at INTERVIEW when latest document is not SIGNED/ACTIVATED
effect: Read private application/revisions, write separate CONTRACT_READ PayrollEvent audit, then allowlist verified contact/identity suggestions; browser prints selected saved revision without source rewrite
alternative: This GET has an audit DB write. Missing historical originals warn; private identity HMAC/decrypt failure503. Saved terms override suggestions and print does not sign/issue/save
persistenceSemantics: Return authorized prefill/document data; print is browser presentation, no source rewrite

title: Reserve and submit legacy weekly settlement
guard: Owned eligible legacy earning IDs, ready approved financial policy/decision versions, durable indexes and transactionally sampled Vietnam weekly quota
effect: Command fingerprint replay, unique sitter/week claim, guarded exact AVAILABLE-to-RESERVED slices, SUBMITTED immutable request and ledger/event/result commit together
alternative: Missing policy/payment/tax/completion, active holds, invalid ledger/quota or stale reservation blocks. Separate employee payroll is not this legacy settlement and no bank send occurs

title: Approve, reject or withdraw settlement
guard: Admin APPROVE/REJECT or owning sitter WITHDRAW, exact current request version, SUBMITTED state and approved action policy
effect: Separate guarded commands approve immutable reserved amount or release slices to HELD/AVAILABLE as active locks require; request CAS, audit/ledger/event/result share transaction
alternative: Approved onward cannot be silently withdrawn; any transfer, hold, version or reservation mismatch blocks/rolls back. Approval does not execute bank transfer

title: Record transfer and reconcile uncertain result
guard: Admin/current approved request version, immutable reserved amount, exact owned private transfer evidence and unique transfer/evidence references; valid real paidAt for confirmed result
effect: Exact CONFIRMED transfer settles reserved ledger slices and request PAID atomically; UNKNOWN or amount mismatch records attempt and TRANSFER_PENDING retaining reserved funds and reference claims
alternative: UNKNOWN is transfer outcome, not a payroll state. Reconcile real evidence before later confirmation; replay or conflicting reference must not double-pay, release or reuse uncertain reference

title: Apply and release a case or refund money hold
guard: Authorized case/refund caller supplies actual shared transaction session, audited actor and exact CASE/REFUND source reference; touch shared booking finance guard and bounded earnings
effect: Lock exact source and AVAILABLE-to-HELD ledger slices; already paid sources create pending Admin-reviewed adjustment; explicit final release only unlocks exact lock and moves funds when no other active lock remains
alternative: No automatic clawback or guessed liability amount; outer caller commits/rolls back. Other active locks and invalid ledger still block availability

title: Publish visit reminders
guard: Exported helper has repository/notifier ports, local inFlight coalescing, bounded upcoming query and Vietnam-time future active visit/reminder/recipient checks
effect: Per eligible schedule-version reminder, optional obsolete invalidation/atomic reservation, notifier send and optional delivered/failed recording; stable identity deduplication is adapter contract
alternative: Job does not mutate Visit. Optional port methods do not prove durable runtime deduplication or startup; ACCEPTED is not inbox delivery

title: Dispatch invitations and expire unanswered offers
guard: Non-overlapping worker; bounded current SCHEDULED queue with approved care plan/payment context, retryAt and current version
effect: For each row call replayable invite with deterministic visit/version key; bounded eligibility and advisory ordering, expire old offers, CAS visit and create next bounded invitations/events; known no-candidate/schedule conflicts CAS Staff review
alternative: Started shifts escalate for real customer schedule resolution; guard/CAS failure rolls back one invitation command, non-409 logs batch failure; UC-35 separately accepts/declines and rechecks occupancy

title: Reconcile payment reminders and overdue state
guard: Repository-supplied due array; payment UNPAID, hold CLEAR, provider NONE or FAILED and valid dueAt<=asOf; local concurrent run coalescing
effect: Send reminder with stable paymentId/dueAt identity via notifier; count only ACCEPTED as reminded and isolate failed/uncertain/missing responses
alternative: Current helper does not reconcile provider, change payment/bill or mark OVERDUE; cadence/deadline policies are integration gates. It does not itself enforce a numeric candidate-count bound

title: Expire unpaid or uncollected product holds
guard: Proposed bounded scheduler requires approved payment/pickup deadline policy, authoritative current order/payment/deadline/version and explicit composition ownership
effect: Proposed transaction deduplicates order/deadline/source identity, cancels only still-eligible unshipped order and releases exact quantityHeld once, preserving stockOnHand and notification intent
alternative: DESIGN_PENDING_RUNTIME: current manual cancel is guarded CAS without stored replay; no full deadline job inferred. Uncertain payment, shipped state or missing policy requires review; prepaid timeout is not automatic refusal

title: Recompute approved customer tier
guard: Proposed annual assessment requires approved effective tier thresholds/discount policy and verified paid receipt IDs/versions, with explicit refund eligibility rules
effect: Proposed source-hash assessment deduplicates customer/year/policy/receipts, computes safe integer annual eligible spend and CASes tier projection/event
alternative: DESIGN_PENDING_RUNTIME: no approved tier source means no invented rank, discount or points; changed receipts/policy must be reviewed and recomputed

title: Plan a feasible sitter visit order
guard: Proposed bounded route-order advice uses current authorized visits, registered day origin/windows, source versions and validated road matrix
effect: Reuse existing insertion/timeline feasibility checks for nonoverlap/buffers/handover/breaks/caps; proposed bounded comparison returns advice after version recheck
alternative: DESIGN_PENDING_RUNTIME: current scheduling helper is not a complete global route-order job. No assignment or traffic-model training; OSRM ETA is not live traffic/label

title: Flag late check-in and operational attention
guard: Exported operational-deadlines sweep requires durable lease/fencing repository ports, limit<=100, expected state/version/time facts and60-second renewed lease
effect: Normalize due no-arrival/no-checkout/handover/change events; atomic repository contract rechecks fencing/current facts and commits operational outbox, isolating candidates and releasing lease finally
alternative: Visit/handover work emits notice, not terminal completion, salary fine or charge. Lost lease stops work; exported helper is not proof of composed live adapters/startup

title: Retry durable application-status email
guard: Application version intent committed before worker; one bounded batch, atomic due-PENDING lease, recheck exact verified recipient
effect: Call SMTP after claim; CAS to ACCEPTED, UNKNOWN, bounded safe-retry PENDING, terminal FAILED or contact SKIPPED
alternative: Uncertain SMTP outcome or expired SENDING lease -> UNKNOWN, no automatic retry; known-safe retry only below three attempts; acceptance is not inbox delivery

title: Search and confirm a service-address map point
guard: Search and resolve use separate session/CSRF-protected map requests and bounded provider calls; explicit pin confirmation is a later Customer decision
effect: LocationSearchService returns suggestions/coordinates only. A separate POST or PATCH /api/v1/pet-care/addresses invokes PetCareManagement with owner/version/area/pin validation and a guarded replayable MongoDB command
alternative: Provider timeout or invalid reference yields map error with no address write; unsupported area, missing pin confirmation, stale version or foreign owner fails the separate address command; existing booking snapshots stay unchanged

title: Read road ETA and bounded route matrix
guard: Exact validated coordinates/directed namespace, deployed coverage, global<=50 points and commercial<=10points/100elements; bounded trusted provider/network/response
effect: Vietmap commercial cacheTtlMs0 skips cache reads/writes; permitted OSRM path reads current edges and writes valid nonnull road ETA edges with15-minute expiry on misses
alternative: No fabricated straight-line ETA, live-traffic/label claim or financial/assignment write. Null route or timeout/invalid response remains explicit unavailable/review

title: Upload and read private care or applicant evidence
guard: Owner-bound authenticated image key/digest/MIME/size/pixels/quota; separate Admin applicant-document authorization and application-bound reference
effect: Reserve PENDING/quota transaction then normalize/upload private R2 outside transaction and mark READY; owner read verifies content digest/type/length; Admin document read commits quota/audit before provider read
alternative: Private image API has no blanket Staff/Admin ownership bypass. Provider uncertainty retains upload slot; R2 read failure does not roll back recorded applicant-document read audit

title: Replace an avatar or product photo
guard: Avatar requires owner/pet scope, expectedVersion/key and bounded JPEG/PNG; product photo requires current Admin permission, Product.detailsVersion/index and bounded supported image
effect: Avatar CAS retains version/present/fingerprint and unsets removed body; product flow updates Product.photos/detailsVersion, upserts normalized digest and deletes unretained product photo blobs transactionally
alternative: No historical media-byte preservation is promised. ProductPhoto has no avatar-style tombstone or stored key replay; stale product operation must reload. Unauthorized, invalid image, stale version and missing reference fail explicitly

title: Send a public contact enquiry
guard: Same-origin public POST with three-per-hour limiter, exact six bounded validated consented fields and configured server inbox/provider
effect: Await direct SYSTEM EMAIL notificationDelivery.send with a new random operationId for each request; return ACCEPTED or safe unavailable/uncertain error without contact DB write
alternative: Uncertain acknowledgement can mean mail was sent; no contact record/outbox/durable retry or cross-request deduplication store, and acceptance is not inbox delivery
persistenceSemantics: External delivery only; no contact database write

title: Install and recover the web application shell
guard: Proposed HTTPS/browser capability, reviewed manifest/icons/service worker scope/version and lifecycle/privacy gates; manifest/SW absent in current frontend
effect: Proposed cache allowlisted public shell assets only, explicit install/update UI; online authenticated API remains authoritative with private no-store
alternative: DESIGN_PENDING_RUNTIME: no offline payment/booking/signature success, cached private API data, guaranteed background GPS or safe automatic financial replay
